question: Alladi Krishnaswami Ayyar was the chairman of the ______ of the Constituent Assembly of India.
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Credential Committee.**__

 
• Alladi Krishnaswami Ayyar was the chairman of the Credential Committee of the Constituent Assembly of India. 
 
• He served as the Advocate General of Madras State from 1929 to 1944.
